title: Typefaces by brand and role

location.format: Editorial comparison of four native screenshot excerpts

slide_intent: Teach designers to choose a face for its reading role within a brand. The same letters can give a headline a distinctive voice and give supporting text a quieter rhythm.
strategic_value: Mozilla and Firefox can share the distinction between headlines and body text while giving each brand its own pair of faces. A reader moving between the brands can encounter both a familiar hierarchy and a different voice.
demonstration: The left column pairs Mozilla Headline with Mozilla Text. The right pairs Metropolis with Inter. Every specimen shows the same letters from Aa through Hh in bold and regular. The role labels group the specimens horizontally.
practical_value: Choose a headline and body pair for a Mozilla or Firefox page. Compare the shape of a matching letter across the row before judging the difference between the roles in a column.
